db:select.db:sql: SELECT f.flag_seq, t.transaction_id, to_char(t.transaction_datetime AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS transaction_datetime, t.account_number, t.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.customer_type, t.transaction_type, t.channel, t.currency, t.amount, t.counterparty_name, t.counterparty_country, f.flag_code, f.flag_reason, to_char(f.flagged_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS flagged_at, f.reviewed_by, f.review_status FROM transaction_flags f JOIN transactions t ON t.transaction_id = f.transaction_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id WHERE f.flagged_at >= CAST(CAST(:periodStart AS text) AS timestamptz) AND f.flagged_at < CAST(CAST(:periodEnd AS text) AS timestamptz) AND f.report_status = :reportStatus ORDER BY f.flagged_at, t.transaction_id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS record_count, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS total_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM transaction_flags f JOIN transactions t ON t.transaction_id = f.transaction_id WHERE f.flagged_at >= CAST(CAST(:periodStart AS text) AS timestamptz) AND f.flagged_at < CAST(CAST(:periodEnd AS text) AS timestamptz) AND f.report_status = :reportStatus
